target_reservoir: Bhatsa Lake (Thane / MMR Data Centre Water Security Basin)

candidate_2_trend_adjusted_baseline.description: 52-week lag adjusted by initial level gap at origin (delta_0 = -30.0 MCM)

candidate_3_regularized_lightgbm.description: Small regularized LightGBM residual regressor (num_leaves=4, n_estimators=15)
candidate_3_regularized_lightgbm.sample_limitation: Only 16 historical training pairs prior to 2024 due to 2022 server 404s

selected_approach.justification: Candidate 2 achieves 10.23 MCM MAE (1.09% of reservoir capacity and 2.89% MAPE) without parameter estimation risk. Candidate 3 (LightGBM) achieves 6.57 MCM on this specific test set, but was fitted on only 16 training samples due to 2022 server missingness, posing severe risk of sample-size overfitting. In accordance with task instructions, Candidate 2 is selected as the primary operational model.

uncertainty_assessment.disclaimer: Uncertainty intervals are based on historical empirical residual quantiles. True calibrated probabilities cannot be guaranteed from a single 26-week backtest window.
